conclusion.statement: A due-diligence memorandum states that Gregory A. Beaumont transferred 100,000 shares to Carrie Canuck, described as a Canadian resident, on June 1, 2022, and characterizes the event as an automatic termination of S-corporation status. The historic-distribution schedules conflict as to the May 22, 2022 total and Michael T. Hartwell's amount, and the 2020 and 2024 K-1 excerpts identify Laura Kensington as a 26% shareholder.
